mapper.select: select trim(a.community_name) as community_name, count(1) as address_count, inet_ntoa(min(a.ip_value)) as first_ip, inet_ntoa(max(a.ip_value)) as last_ip, group_concat(distinct nullif(trim(n.network_name), '') order by n.start_value separator '、') as network_name_summary, group_concat(distinct nullif(trim(n.police_station_name), '') order by n.police_station_name separator '、') as police_station_summary from ipam_address a left join ipam_network n on n.network_id = a.network_id where a.status in ('ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED') and nullif(trim(a.community_name), '') is not null group by trim(a.community_name) order by min(a.ip_value)

select a.address_id, a.network_id, a.segment_id, a.ip_address, a.ip_value, a.status, a.community_name, a.internal_ip_address, a.target_type, a.target_name, a.manufacturer, a.access_unit, a.purpose, a.login_username, case when nullif(a.login_password, '') is not null then 1 else 0 end as credential_configured, a.mapping_address, a.mapping_port, a.mapping_description, a.owner_name, a.owner_phone, a.remark, n.network_name, n.cidr_block as network_cidr, s.segment_name, s.cidr_block as segment_cidr, n.police_station_name, scan.connectivity_status, scan.response_time_ms, scan.last_scan_time, scan.last_online_time from ipam_address a left join ipam_network n on n.network_id = a.network_id left join ipam_segment s on s.segment_id = a.segment_id left join ipam_scan_result scan on scan.ip_address = a.ip_address where a.status in ('ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED') and trim(a.community_name) = #{communityName} order by a.ip_value
